label: Q01
question: What licence applies to the eDNA detection table?
context: marmam-app's LICENSE (MIT) covers the app code, not the data. The release refuses license = unknown without this question open. Checked 2026-09-27: marmam-app's LICENSE is MIT, 'Copyright (c) 2024 PSTAT197-F23' (the UCSB data-science capstone that built the app), and grants rights over 'this software and associated documentation files'. The class did not collect the data, so it cannot license them; the lab must name the data licence.

label: Q02
question: How should the dataset be cited, and is it deposited anywhere?
context: No citation or DOI is given in marmam-app.

label: Q03
question: Who curates this table: the Scripps Whale Acoustics Lab (provider sio) or NCOG / JCVI (provider jcvi, beside jcvi_ncog-metabarcoding)?
context: The samples are NCOG's; the cetacean screening appears to be the lab's. The provider decides the dataset_key, so this must be settled before release.
proposed_answer: provider = sio, dataset = cetacean-edna; NCOG credited in the description.

label: Q04
question: Does 'not sequenced PCR negative' mean no cetacean DNA was detected, i.e. an absence for all seven species?
context: The ingest publishes edna_presence = 0 for all seven species on those samples, with measurement_qual naming the process. marmam-app's README describes edna.csv as 'eDNA sequencing effort and detections', one row per station and depth, which supports reading a PCR-negative row as a screened sample with no detection.
proposed_answer: Yes: PCR-negative samples are absences (0) for all seven species; measurement_qual carries 'not sequenced PCR negative' verbatim so a consumer can exclude them.

label: Q05
question: Three samples are listed twice, once sequenced and once PCR-negative (201604_093.3_026.7_9, 201607_093.3_045.0_9, 201611_081.8_046.9_20). Which is right?
context: Two of the three sequenced rows carry a detection.
proposed_answer: Keep the sequenced row and drop the PCR-negative duplicate.

label: Q06
question: Can the sampling date/time be supplied?
context: The table gives only year, season and cruise; the ingest dates each sample by the ichthyo station occupation at the same station on that cruise. CC1611 (Sally Ride, no ichthyo tows) takes cruise_key 2016-11-33P4 from the release's CTD casts (sightings Q14) but no time.
proposed_answer: datetime = matched station occupation (same site_key, within 25 days of the cruise month's 15th). The NCOG bottle trip time would be better, and is the only way to time the 16 CC1611 samples.

label: Q07
question: Which assay/marker was used, and were only these seven species screened (Gg, Tt, Mn, Dc, Lb, Lo, Dd)?
context: An absence (0) is published only for these seven; any other species is not claimed absent.
proposed_answer: Presence/absence published for the seven columns only.

label: Q08
question: Confirm the taxa behind Dc and Lo.
context: WoRMS treats Delphinus capensis as a nomen dubium and Lagenorhynchus obliquidens as a junior synonym of Sagmatias obliquidens.
proposed_answer: Dc -> Delphinus capensis (worms:383816, nomen dubium, review), kept distinct from Dd as farallon LBCD; keying it to D. delphis gave each sample two conflicting D. delphis rows. Lo -> Sagmatias obliquidens (worms:1571909). Both via taxon_override.csv, as in sio_cetacean-sightings.

label: Q09
question: Five samples are at 515 m and four at 170 m. Are those depths right?
context: The rest are 0-100 m. The depth is also in each sample name (e.g. 201504_081.8_046.9_515), at the two NCOG deep stations 81.8/46.9 and 76.7/70.0, so the column matches the name.

label: Q10
question: On 7 rows the line/station columns disagree with the sample name: six 201407-201504 samples say line 81.9 for 081.8_046.9, and 201404_086.7_070.0_12 says station 46.9. Which is right?
context: Each row's own latitude/longitude sits on the sample name's station (81.8/46.9 and 86.7/70.0), not on the columns'. Taking the columns put those 7 samples on stations ichthyo never occupies, so they got no time.
proposed_answer: The sample name (and the position) are right: line/station are taken from the name, and the ingest asserts the position agrees within 0.02 degrees.
